name: qft5
description: 5-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (structured, many small rotations)
qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from math import pi

# 5-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform, written out:
# H and controlled phases on each qubit, then swaps
n = 5
qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
for j in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    qc.h(j)
    for k in range(j - 1, -1, -1):
        qc.cp(pi / 2 ** (j - k), k, j)
for i in range(n // 2):
    qc.swap(i, n - 1 - i)

name: toffoli
description: Toffoli gate in Clifford+T (tiny, already near optimal)
qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# Toffoli gate: flips qubit 2 when qubits 0 and 1 are both 1
qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)

name: adder
qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# Cuccaro ripple-carry adder, 2+2 bits
# qubit 0 carry in; a = qubits 1, 3; b = qubits 2, 4; qubit 5 carry out
qc = QuantumCircuit(6)

# MAJ(carry in, b0, a0)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.cx(1, 0)
qc.ccx(0, 2, 1)
# MAJ(a0, b1, a1)
qc.cx(3, 4)
qc.cx(3, 1)
qc.ccx(1, 4, 3)
# copy the carry out
qc.cx(3, 5)
# UMA(a0, b1, a1)
qc.ccx(1, 4, 3)
qc.cx(3, 1)
qc.cx(1, 4)
# UMA(carry in, b0, a0)
qc.ccx(0, 2, 1)
qc.cx(1, 0)
qc.cx(0, 2)

name: grover3
qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# 3-qubit Grover iteration: oracle marking |101>, then the diffuser
qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
qc.h(range(3))

# oracle
qc.x(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
qc.h(2)
qc.x(1)

# diffuser
qc.h(range(3))
qc.x(range(3))
qc.h(2)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
qc.h(2)
qc.x(range(3))
qc.h(range(3))
